yeah like its genuinely embarrassing how much real estate it takes up in my brain. it was my final year capstone, four of us, and i basically ended up doing the whole thing the night before because everyone vanished. got us the grade but

loaded is a strong word for a powerpoint lol. but ok yeah. i think the part that actually bugs me is i never said anything. just quietly fixed it and smiled and let them put their names on it. and now any time someone slacks me last minute my whole body goes into capstone mode

yeah that fits. its the swallowing it part. like i wasnt even mad at them really, i was mad that i let it happen and didnt say a word. and i still kinda do that? i over-function so nobody else has to and then im surprised im fried. cool pattern. love that for me

ok the self-critical thing got me a little. didnt come here to get read like that lol. yeah. its easier to be annoyed at them than to look at the part where i never let myself take up space. thats the actual heavy thing i guess

lets leave it there i think. brain is full. but yeah. thanks for not letting me joke my way out of it entirely. gonna go sit with the heavy bit and probably reply to a slack message way too fast lol. take care
